mother_note: If Noa called, tell her the box was not thrown away. It is where Dad always said there is nothing.
noa_journal: Tuesday. Mom asked again if I heard the knocking. I said no. I don't know if she believes me, or if she only wants me to say it.
yoav_note: Fix the back lock. Do not replace the door. It was not broken from the outside.
miriam_letter: Eitan, if you got this far, it means I never managed to say this while I was alive. I'm not asking you to forgive me. I'm asking you not to confuse what you remember with what we told you so you could sleep. There are three knocks in this story, but not every one was heard on the same night. — Mom
noa_farewell: I left before you arrived. You have to see it yourself. Choose what you can live with. — Noa
folded_note: He came back, but not through the front door.
repair_doc: Rear lock reset. Door not forced from outside. Paid cash. Dated the week of the storm.
photo_key: The evening we counted to three.
house_plan: One room circled twice: behind the service cabinet.
back_door: Locked from the inside. A new lock, brighter than the door. Fixed after the storm, not forced.
